payload.body: DONE + committed 4b468ff. Cross-impl conformance loop closed: scripts/conformance-ts-server.ts boots the TS server with productTestSchema; the frick-conformance suite (12 black-box scenarios) now PASSES against BOTH the in-process Rust server (default) AND the live TS server (FRICK_CONFORMANCE_URL). New CI job conformance-cross-impl runs it against the TS server; the Rust-server run is in the workspace test job. The run found + I fixed one real wire-parity bug (object-Delta id-strip, efc1840) and surfaced one expected divergence (WebRTCSignal call gate — FR-15 deferred in Rust, scenario tolerates both). Acceptance layer is comprehensive: 73 golden wire fixtures + 81 lint + codegen + migrations fixtures + 12 cross-impl black-box scenarios, all gated in CI.
